==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I have found a badge belonging to a superhero team that I didn't think actually existed. I have traveled to a city where superhero teams are common place to find the team the badge belongs to. I quickly forget about my mission as I start exploring the city.

Two superhero teams decide to vandalize each other's towers with graffiti. It is interesting and distressing to see superheroes beef like gangs over turf. I don't quite know why they can't just work together.

I spot a living car driving itself down the street. It has eyes and a mouth, and it appears to be covered in rust. I wonder if it is a superhero with the power to become a car, or a superhero's car that happens to be alive.
